text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed our sampleapp logs (node vs go) diverge when OTEL hooks are enabled: different log levels and request-id padding gone in Node.

tom: which sampleapp/branch? link to repro?

maria: examples/telemetry/sampleapp on telemetry-fix branch. Node default LOG_LEVEL=info, Go default DEBUG. Also Node loses leading zeros in reqid after otel hook runs.

ana: can repro locally. paste of logs below. Node BEFORE hook:
```
INFO  [req=0000a3] request started x=42
```
Go BEFORE hook:
```
DEBUG [req=0000a3] request started x=42
```
Node AFTER enabling OTEL_LOGGING_HOOK=true:
```
INFO  [req=a3] request started x=42
```
so the reqid formatting got trimmed.

jeff: sounds like our log formatter is interacting with the OTEL hook ordering. In Go the reqid middleware is applied before OTEL injection, in Node it's currently after — so the hook mutates the field.

infra-bot: deploybot: new build finished for telemetry-fix (sha abc123) :white_check_mark:

ana: quick test: swapping middleware order in node fixes it. patch idea: `middleware.unshift(attachReqId)` — that preserves padded id.

tom: we should standardize this across SDKs and sample apps. propose: 1) standard middleware order in quickstart 2) integration test asserting reqid unchanged pre/post hook 3) document LOG_LEVEL defaults for sampleapps.

maria: I'll open a GH issue and assign. Created tracking issue: https://github.com/redwood/example/issues/2123 (assigning to @ana)

ana: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/example/pull/45 includes middleware reorder, a tiny integration test that starts sampleapp with OTEL env var and checks log lines, and README updates. Also added OTEL sampler example for the sample app:
```js
const { NodeTracerProvider } = require('@opentelemetry/node');
const { ParentBasedSampler, TraceIdRatioBasedSampler } = require('@opentelemetry/core');
const provider = new NodeTracerProvider({
  sampler: new ParentBasedSampler(new TraceIdRatioBasedSampler(0.1))
});
provider.register();
```

jeff: looks good. one more: redaction rules. we currently run a redaction regex that accidentally matches short hex-like tokens and redacts part of reqid when email-like redactions run. need to restrict regex to email patterns and leave request ids alone.

tom: :thumbsup: add a targeted redaction test. also can we add a CI matrix job that runs sampleapp with OTEL_LOGGING_HOOK true/false and node/go combos?

maria: yes, adding matrix job in .github/workflows/telemetry-matrix.yml. will include node:14/18 and go1.20 and toggles for OTEL envs. ETA: tomorrow. tagging @ana for follow-up.

ana: on it, will merge after green CI. small note: updated sampleapp quickstart to document LOG_LEVEL env and that OTEL hook can change ordering effects. happy to follow up if tests catch other parity gaps. :pray:
